## Type

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run validate` passes locally (format, lint, types, tests, build)
- [ ] New logic has unit tests; new UI behaviour has an integration test
- [ ] `npm run docs:diagram` re-run if `src/config/window-manifest.ts` changed
- [ ] Documentation updated (`README.md` and/or `docs/`)
- [ ] The change keeps the fiction coherent — see `docs/creative-methodology.md`
